text_solutions.text:
"Explain Question:
The question asks to match specific chemical compounds with their appropriate purification techniques based on their physical properties.
Concept:
• Vacuum Distillation: For liquids that decompose at high temperatures (Glycerol).
• Steam Distillation: For steam-volatile, water-insoluble substances (o-Nitrophenol).
• Sublimation: For solids that transition directly to gas (Anthracene).
• Fractional Distillation: For mixtures with close boiling points (Crude oil).
Solution:
• Glycerol (A): Decomposes at its boiling point, so Vacuum distillation (4) is used.
• o-Nitrophenol (B): Steam volatile due to intramolecular H-bonding, so Steam distillation (3) is used.
• Anthracene (C): A sublimable solid, so Sublimation (2) is used.
• Crude oil (D): A mixture of hydrocarbons with varying boiling points, so Fractional distillation (1) is used.
Final Answer: Option (1)"

"(1) Glycerol → Vacuum distillation
(2) O-Nitrophenol → Steam distillation
(3) Anthracene → Sublimation
(4) Crude oil → Fractional distillation"

Explain Question: The question is asking: How many of the given statements about plant growth and differentiation are incorrect.
Concept: Characteristics of Plant Growth and  Differentiation.
Solution: 
(A) In plants growth and differentiation are open 
Correct . Plant growth is considered "open" because plants retain the capacity for unlimited growth throughout their life due to the presence of meristems. Similarly, differentiation is open because cells arising from the same meristem can have different structures at maturity.
(B) The final structure at maturity of a cell or tissue determined by the location of cell 
Correct . In plants, the "fate" of a cell is often governed by its position. For example, cells positioned on the outside will become dermal tissue, while those in the center become vascular tissue.
(C) Cell positioned away from root apical meristem mature as epidermis, and those pushed to the periphery differentiate as root cap cells 
Incorrect. Cells positioned away from root apical meristems differentiate as root-cap cells, while those pushed to the periphery mature as epidermis. 
(D) Environmental signals such as light, temperature and gravity also affect certain phases and stages of growth 
Correct . Environmental factors influence plant growth.
Counting incorrect statements: Only (C) is incorrect → 1 statement
Final answer: Option 1
